ios.desc:
HOW TO USE DRESSME:

1) Answer lifestyle questions to create your plan

2) Snap a picture of your outfits

3) Get ai-powered result on which outfit is better


Upgrade your fashion game with our intuitive and intelligent outfit planning app!

SMART: Our advanced AI model analyzes your outfit options and fashion preferences to select the perfect outfit for any occasion. Say goodbye to decision fatigue and hello to effortlessly stylish looks every day.

PERSONAL: The app takes into account real-time weather data based on your location, ensuring that your outfit is not only stylish but also appropriate for the conditions outside. Whether it's sunny, rainy, or snowy, you'll be dressed to impress.

FAST: Get outfit recommendations in just 3 seconds! With our rapid AI processing, you can quickly brainstorm and explore different outfit combinations. Find the perfect look without wasting time.

quotes.text:
I made DressMe for people including myself that are having a hard time choosing between outfits to wear.

It accepts two pictures of outfits, looks at weather conditions based on your location, take your personal context. Then it will select better outfit from those 2 and provide reasons why it did so.

I would really appreciate your feedback. Thank you!
